name: Vol Surface
description: Implied-vol surfaces from two long option chains: CFTC FX options (the CFTC FX Implied Volatility (Options) widget; the wide CFTC FX vol widget is a separate card) and yfinance stock-option chains. Each tab: the chain, a linked pivot report and a linked Surface per underlying. Cells are medians with no outlier trim; vols are decimal fractions (0.054 is 5.4%). Opens in BDOBB 11.0.0 or later.

formulas.name: strike_bucket
formulas.expression: IF(ndf, IF(bp_distance > 1750, null, IF(strike_bp < 0, -1, 1) * IF(bp_distance < 25, 0, IF(bp_distance < 75, 50, IF(bp_distance < 150, 100, IF(bp_distance < 250, 200, IF(bp_distance < 400, 300, IF(bp_distance < 625, 500, IF(bp_distance < 875, 750, IF(bp_distance < 1250, 1000, 1500))))))))), IF(strike_distance > 1250, null, IF(strike_points < 0, -1, 1) * IF(strike_distance < 12.5, 0, IF(strike_distance < 37.5, 25, IF(strike_distance < 75, 50, IF(strike_distance < 125, 100, IF(strike_distance < 200, 150, IF(strike_distance < 375, 250, IF(strike_distance < 750, 500, 1000)))))))))

formulas.name: side
formulas.expression: IF(option_type = "call", IF(strike >= underlying_price, "OTM call", "ITM call"), IF(strike < underlying_price, "OTM put", "ITM put"))

formulas.name: side
formulas.expression: IF(option_type = "call", IF(strike >= underlying_price, "OTM call", "ITM call"), IF(strike < underlying_price, "OTM put", "ITM put"))
